metadata.description: Give Claude a video input. /watch pulls the transcript by default (captions or Whisper fallback, no video download); add --frames to also download the video and extract frames, then hands it all to Claude.

plugins.name: watch
plugins.description: Watch a video (URL or local path). Transcript-first by default: pulls native captions (or Whisper fallback) with no video download. Add --frames to also download the video and extract frames with ffmpeg.

author.name: Lutz Leonhardt (fork of upstream by Bradley Bonanno)
